name: LI-PCIEFG-GMSL2

sources.title: LI-PCIEFG-GMSL2 datasheet (Leopard Imaging; revision 0.1, 17 Mar 2022 in its revision history)
sources.covers: camera adapter interfaces, deserializer, FPGA, PCIe interface, camera count, connector, weight, size, supported cameras

note: A PCIe video grabber (SX proFRAME 3.0 base board and camera adapters, Maxim MAX9296A deserializers, Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ ZU4CG) that "can connect up to 8 cameras" (gmsl_links 8) on FAKRA Z connectors. Stated: "2 x SX proFRAME 3.0 Camera Adapter interfaces, each with: 4 x CSI-2 interfaces (4 lanes), each up to 10 Gbit/s, total 40 Gbit/s" (ports 2: the adapters; ingest lists each adapter); "PCIe X8 Gen3 (64 Gbit/s, ~51 Gbit/s netto) to backplane" (the card's uplink; practical_mbps 51000 is that stated net figure, the card's total, not a per-link rate). 8 to 24 VDC power over coax for the cameras; a 12 V external input (J2003); the card's own power is not stated. Weight "~ 191 g". Size "175.26 (L) x 106.68 (W) x 19.45 (D) mm" with the camera adapter (size_mm as stated: length, width, depth). The GMSL2 link rate is not stated in the datasheet (it is the deserializer's; stated_mbps null). Operating temperature -20 to +85 °C. The supported-camera table lists Leopard GMSL2 modules (IMX490, AR0820, AR0231, AR0233, AR0239) and "Other YUV GMSL2 modules".
